chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Ibrahim al-Khazzaz, from 'Uthman al-Nawwa', who said:

I said to Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام: I wash the dead. He said: Do you do it well? He said: I said: I wash [them]. He said: When you wash the deceased, then be gentle with him, do not squeeze him, and do not bring anything of camphor near his hearing passages.

key_terms.بِكَافُورٍ: with camphor, a substance used in funeral washing
key_terms.فَارْفُقْ: be gentle and treat with care
key_terms.مَسَامِعِهِ: his hearing passages, meaning the ears

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased be treated during ghusl according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives guidance on the proper manner of performing ghusl for the deceased. It emphasizes gentleness and care for the body of the dead, and instructs that camphor should not be brought near the ears.
